details:
Currently there is a notification sound.

Yet the problem is that the sound is quiet and also the sound goes away quick. Sometimes that may be nice and good.

But other times when you are distracted or have on other sounds such as music, or looking at a movie, or noisy people around you or something, the sound wont really be picked up well. Also its not like we are keeping up the menu at all times.

It would be nice to have different sound options such as short sounds, or even long sounds that isnt annoying and is good to listen to. Different sounds for different people.

Example: having cute sounds short and long options, having cool sounds short and long options, having just normal such as the current sound short and long, scary sounds, pretty sounds, curious sounds, funny sounds, list goes on. Creativity is the rule.

Also the sound should be increased as the sound is very quiet as i have it at maximum by UI, but still that isnt enough to hear it properly without it being completely quiet. 

Thank you for reading!
title: Different options for sound on VRC
